Open thread • Replies: 18 • Updated: 2026-10-19 21:24 UTC

OP

Whats up /biz,

Im looking to invest about 10k, and I have been thinking about "Building Dehydrators", which is hopefully the right translation from the German word "Bautrockner". I have been calculating it the last few days and buying some of these machines makes sense to then rent them out and building a little business around that. There are a couple of Dehydrators that are not that expensive and could still potentially bring in about 50 to 70 Euros a week. Which would be great for a 400 to 800 investment per machine.

Does anyone have experience in that regard? Im also thinking about renting about washing machines and dryers for private households.

Its not something that will get rented out 100% of the time, thats for sure!

dont building companies already have these machines for themselves?

As I researched it a little bit, especially in Winter-times these machines are being sought after because the walls dont dry as easily as in the summer heat/time.
